data.text: Folks, my family taught me to leave enough fish for next season. With 100 tons now, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50 to reproduce, and have a full lake again next month. That’s $10,000 apiece every month if we stick together. I propose we all agree to that limit and review the catches together afterward. John, would you be willing to commit to 10 tons?
